senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to be arched; denom. חוֹב II;] to bosom, love.
same, to love, cherish; with לפני or בפני, to prefer.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 27:8">Ex. R. s. 27</cite>; Tanḥ. Yithro 4 Yithro is named <he>חוֹבָב</he>, <he>שח׳ את וכ׳</he> because he loved the Law; <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 78:1">Sifré Num. 78</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 13b:4">Sabb. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>היו מְחַבְּבִין את הצרות</he> they cherished the memory of past troubles (devoting memorial days to the relief from them).
<cite ref="Shabbat 51a">Ib. 51ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>כמה מחבבין זה את זה</he> how they honor each other.

<cite ref="Pesachim 100a">Pes. 100ᵃ</cite> <he>בכל יום היית מחבב … בפני</he> thou didst always prefer my opinions to those of R. J., and now thou embracest his opinion in my presence; Y. ib. X, beg. 37ᵇ; <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 5:2">Tosef. Ber. V, 2</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:9">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>כדי לחַבְּבָהּ בעיניו</he> in order to make him feel the dearness of home; <he>כדי לחַבְּבוֹ וכ׳</he> to make him feel how dear was his son to him.
